title: pterocarpus javanicus
intro: Pterocarpus javanicus, commonly known as Javan Kerosene tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may aid in reducing oxidative stress and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Pterocarpus javanicus include its use in treating various conditions, such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of this plant, particularly flavonoids, have been identified as responsible for its therapeutic properties, including flavanones, flavan-3-ols, and isoflavones.
